title: Chapter 1271
text:
Before Han Xiao could respond to this male elf, the other revivors were already in an uproar. They all distanced themselves and looked at the Holy Covenant members warily.

"Didn't I die? How did I come back to life? What did you do to me? "

"Where is this? Who are you? "

"What's going on? Is this the enemy's trap?"

Shock and panic quickly spread through the crowd. All kinds of shouts and angry shouts rang out one after another, creating a chaotic scene.

Even with the temperament of a Beyond Grade A, the sudden reality of being revived was a huge blow to their hearts.

Seeing that the commotion was getting bigger and bigger, Han Xiao took a deep breath. Then, his face tightened, and his pressure suddenly erupted!

"Everyone, quiet down!"

Boom!

Like a thunderstorm, Han Xiao's energy fluctuation suddenly swept through the entire place, and golden arcs of electricity flickered in the air.

A huge pressure suddenly descended on every revivor present. It was as if the stop button had been pressed, and all the noise disappeared. Everyone shut their mouths, and all kinds of shocked, shocked, and fearful gazes focused on Han Xiao.

This feeling was like being at the center of a Primordial Psionic Energy explosion. The pressure came from the outside, stimulating their extremely strong sense of danger. They were like prey targeted by a hunter, and their bodies could not help but tense up.

There were also peak Beyond Grade As in this batch of revivors. They were originally watching the situation with cold eyes, but at this moment, their expressions suddenly changed, and they looked at Han Xiao in shock.

This powerful energy seemed to be stronger than anyone they had ever seen before!!

This guy in black in front of them most likely had the ability to take away their lives!

This time, before this batch of revivors could react, the other Holy Covenant members stood with their arms crossed, coldly staring at everyone present, and also burst out with auras!

Bang bang bang bang!

The energy fluctuations of dozens of Beyond Grade As intertwined, resulting in an intense collision. Shockwaves burst out one after another, and the entire alloy room shook!

"These people are all Beyond Grade As?"

The expressions of the revivors present changed drastically, and they were greatly shocked. Their hearts were shaken by this mixed aura.

The pressure only lasted for three seconds before Han Xiao ordered everyone to withdraw.

The effect of this display of power was obvious. No one dared to move anymore. When Han Xiao saw that everyone had finally quieted down, he smiled.

"It seems that everyone has calmed down. Very good, then we can sit down and have a good talk."

Hearing this, the many revivors looked around at the dozens of Holy Covenant Beyond Grade As present and decisively chose to follow their hearts, obediently waiting for the rest of the story.

Seeing this, Han Xiao cleared his throat and tried his best to maintain a friendly tone as he slowly said,

"I know everyone needs an explanation. It's now Galaxy Calendar Year 780. You're all Beyond Grade As who died in different eras. The reason you're here is because we've discovered a unique method to bring you back from the dead!"

As soon as he finished speaking, although the revivors present had already guessed it, they could not help but feel shocked when they heard the confirmation.

'How could such a thing happen? We can still live again?!'

For a moment, everyone's mood was very complicated, half happy and half worried.

Although coming back from the dead was a pleasant surprise, most of them still felt awkward. You dug us out without our permission!

This service was definitely not free. The other party must have ulterior motives!

"So this is not the world after death …" At this time, the elf man with a mouth full of honey seemed to have just reacted. He then looked at Han Xiao with a strange expression and frowned. "Then why are you dressed like this? Do you think you have a personality? "

“？？？”

Han Xiao was confused. He could not help but look down at his clothes. They were a little black, but the style was quite exquisite.

Is there something wrong with this person's aesthetics? My officers clearly think that it looks good!

Furthermore, he actually despises my attire in such a serious occasion. Is this the time to be fussing over such details?

Han Xiao sized him up, flipped through his memory palace, and quickly found the life history of this elf man.

'Elf King' Dylan, a peak Beyond Grade A Mage. This was a fierce person who was active from the end of the exploration era to the early Galaxy Era. His status back then was roughly equivalent to the current Dark Emperor, Void Overlord, and Mecha Empire. He was also one of the representatives of the Beyond Grade As of this era.

The elves were like the galactic humans, a large race in the universe with a large number of branches. At that time, Dylan displayed his appeal and gathered the scattered branch races one after another, establishing a huge force that belonged to the elves. Its nature was similar to the 'Dragonblood Nation' of the old dragon. It was a glorious period in the history of the elves in the universe.

At that time, the three Universal Civilizations extended an olive branch to Dylan, but he rejected it. He turned around and established an alliance with many Supercluster civilizations.

The reason for this choice seemed to be that he felt that he could only choose one of the three Universal Civilizations, but if he turned around and cooperated with the Supercluster, he could eat the resources of several civilizations and have more freedom.

In the end, Dylan died in the Tragedy of the Pinnacles.

'So it's this guy. That's not strange …' Han Xiao came to a realization.

According to the records, Dylan had a strange personality. He never cared about the occasion or timing when he spoke, and he never cared about the emotions of others. This caused him to have a very bad relationship with the Beyond Grade As at that time, and he had many enemies.

In his last battle, a total of twelve Beyond Grade As came to beat him up and turned him into ashes.

'This treatment is almost as good as mine …'

Han Xiao cursed in his mind.

As for the direction of this guy's decision, Han Xiao could not judge. After all, the era was different, and the environment was different.

In Dylan's era, because there was no precedent, the Supercluster was still openly competing with the three Universal Civilizations for Beyond Grade A allies, using a more relaxed contract to attract experts. At that time, joining the Supercluster was a very normal thing. Not many people would have thought that the Tragedy of the Pinnacles would suddenly erupt.

Han Xiao curled his lips and ignored him. He looked away and continued to speak to the crowd.

"I know that everyone still has a lot of questions, such as who we are, how we can revive you, and the goal of reviving you. My friend will explain these questions to everyone."

Hearing this, Oathkeeper took a step forward and said with a deep voice,

"Everyone, we are a secret organization called the Holy Covenant. We were established by a portion of the Primordial Ones during the exploration years. Our core goal is to revive you in the future. As for the method to revive you, it's a phenomenon called the Sanctum Revival …"

Oathkeeper had already prepared a draft. He explained the origin and mission of the Holy Covenant in detail and answered everyone's doubts.

The Primordial Ones were very famous. Everyone sized up the members of the Holy Covenant one by one and realized that they were indeed the Primordial Ones in history. They gradually believed Oathkeeper's words.

"Then, who is he? There doesn't seem to be such a person among the Primordial Ones. "

This time, someone looked at Han Xiao, and everyone else looked over.

Hearing this, Han Xiao tidied his clothes.

"You can call me Black Star. I'm the leader of the Beyond Grade As of this era."

As soon as this was said, everyone's expression changed.

Leader of the Beyond Grade As?

What arrogance!

In our era, even the strongest Beyond Grade A would not dare to call themselves the leader of the entire organization. Who are you? How dare you give yourself such a title!

Oathkeeper coughed and said, "Let me introduce you.

His Excellency Black Star is not a member of the Holy Covenant but an important partner of ours in this era. We have the same goal. In this era, the Beyond Grade As have already established an association and united. Black Star is the president of the Beyond Grade A Association, and his strength is also at the top of the universe. At the same time, he's also the only common consultant of the three Universal Civilizations. His position is extraordinary … "

After hearing this explanation, everyone was surprised and could not help but size Han Xiao up again.

President of the Beyond Grade A Association, common consultant of the three Universal Civilizations … These titles did not exist in the past. Although they were not clear about the details, just from the title alone, they could already vaguely feel Han Xiao's influence.

Thinking back to the Energy Rank that Han Xiao had just displayed, most of them put away their thoughts of disdain and deeply remembered Black Star in their hearts.

They did not expect such an outstanding junior to appear in the 'future'. Maybe this guy called Black Star was the best Beyond Grade A in history …

This time, another peak Beyond Grade A on the revival list spoke up and said calmly, "Whether you're strong or not is your business. I just want to know, you didn't revive us just to play Wayne Cards with us, right? Or are you trying to use us to help you achieve some goals, such as dominating the universe? "

Han Xiao shook his head and chuckled.

"You must be joking. The Holy Covenant organization and I disturbed your sleep not because of personal ambitions but because the entire Beyond Grade A class has reached a critical moment and needs to borrow the strength of seniors like you!"

As soon as this was said, many people present felt their faces light up and were immediately interested.

"Tell me in detail, why are the Beyond Grade As in a critical moment?" another person asked curiously.

"This is related to the three Universal Civilizations …"

Han Xiao explained the key issues such as the unity of the Beyond Grade A Association, the attitude of the three Universal Civilizations, the significance of the Sanctum Revival to both parties, and so on. He tried his best to analyze the current situation of the Beyond Grade As in simple terms.

Seeing that everyone had fallen into deep thought, Han Xiao added another sentence.

"If this problem is not dealt with properly, it can be foreseen that the Beyond Grade A group will welcome a second Tragedy of the Pinnacles!"

As soon as this was said, many people present trembled.

Many people were victims of the Tragedy of the Pinnacles, and this term hit their sensitive spot.

Seeing this, Han Xiao struck while the iron was hot. He softened his tone and said earnestly,

He softened his tone and said, "This matter is closely related to all of you. It's not just a matter of our era. Even if you don't want to participate, you have to consider your own interests.

It wasn't easy for you to come back from the dead, so you definitely want to continue enjoying life. However, if you don't solve this problem, you won't be able to guarantee your own safety. You have to know that there's only one chance for the Sanctum Revival. If you don't unite and cause the second Tragedy of the Pinnacles to erupt, you'll also be in danger. If you're killed, your lives will truly end. "

Han Xiao deliberately hid the secret of the unlimited Sanctum Revival like Oathkeeper, misleading them that there was only one chance for revival. This way, his persuasiveness was shocking.

Hearing this, everyone understood the relationship between them, and their expressions became serious.

Dylan pinched his chin and pondered. "In that case, there are only two paths in front of us. We can either join the Beyond Grade A Association or stay in the Holy Accord. We have to choose one of the two. There's no other choice."

"Can't we leave alone?" someone asked with a frown.

Dylan glanced at him disdainfully and snorted. "Use your few brain cells to think. The information about the Sanctum Revival is so important. Would they let someone who knows about it move freely? How stupid. No wonder you were beaten to death. "

This person's expression froze, and he said indignantly, "What's there to be smug about? Aren't you the same?"

"What do you know? That's called a strategic death!" Dylan snorted.

Everyone immediately raised their eyebrows.

This saying was f * cking fresh.

However, although Dylan was a weirdo, everyone admitted that what he said made sense.

There were only two choices in front of them. If they wanted to obtain freedom as soon as possible, they had to put their names in the Beyond Grade A Association and let the galactic society, especially the three Universal Civilizations, know of their existence.

If they chose to stay in the Holy Covenant, they would be hiding in the dark. No one would know of their existence, and even if the purge happened, they would not be blamed, so they would not have to take the risk.

They could either choose safety or a certain degree of freedom. There was no third path … If they planned to sneak away and hide their names, they would most likely end up lying back in their coffins.

Everyone was conflicted.

Most people were more inclined to stay in the Holy Covenant. At most, they would not have freedom for a period of time. It was better than losing their second life. If the Beyond Grade A Association succeeded, they would be able to enjoy the fruits of victory together. If the association failed, they would still be able to protect themselves.

Han Xiao saw everyone's hesitation. He knew that his words were effective and was secretly happy.

However, at this moment, an untimely voice suddenly sounded from the crowd.

"Why must we accept such harsh conditions? Everyone, they have a lot of people, and we have a lot of people too. Why don't we join forces for the time being and charge out in one wave? They won't be able to stop all of us. That way, everyone will be able to obtain freedom! "

As soon as these words were said, the expressions of many of the revivors present changed, and they were tempted.

Han Xiao's face darkened, and he looked in the direction of the voice.

"Alright, I thought the problem could be solved so smoothly, but it seems like some people still need to be corrected physically."
